title: Got a new bonus for providing paper trading insights
author: Cute-Opposite4751
selftext:
I've been trading with UpsideOnly since the very beginning and I'm glad to see the company is rewarding its early users. Even if its a small amount I'm glad that they value our time and insights!

One other thing I'd like to add is, I remember being upset about withdrawls cuz I didn't know what was happening with the platform... I sent over some messages and its been taken care of! so it makes me happy to know the company has been listening to the community and following our requests. 

Just curious, has anyone here already checked UpsideOnly? Would be great to hear your thoughts about the company and your experience with the platform!
